title: Slap bass technique and the scarred Rittner bass
summary: Manno explains how Charlie Rittner's habit of striking the bass with the bow led to slapping and pulling the strings, and how the hand moves.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
